entries.text: You see Jain
entries.source_text: You see Jain

entries.text: 你看见简恩。
entries.source_text: 你看见简恩。

entries.text: Why do you disturb an elder of the Cathedral?
entries.source_text: Why do you disturb an elder of the Cathedral?

entries.text: 你为什么要来打扰一位大教堂高级牧师？
entries.source_text: 你为什么要来打扰一位大教堂高级牧师？

entries.text: I have come seeking a blessing.
entries.source_text: I have come seeking a blessing.

entries.text: 我是来乞求祝福的。
entries.source_text: 我是来乞求祝福的。

entries.text: I'm interested in your church, and I want some information. Do you have any pamphlets?
entries.source_text: I'm interested in your church, and I want some information. Do you have any pamphlets?

entries.text: 我对你们大教堂很感兴趣，我想打听些消息。你们有宣传手册吗？
entries.source_text: 我对你们大教堂很感兴趣，我想打听些消息。你们有宣传手册吗？

entries.text: Just looking around.
entries.source_text: Just looking around.

entries.text: 我是来观光的。
entries.source_text: 我是来观光的。

entries.text: Mom?
entries.source_text: Mom?

entries.text: 妈咪？
entries.source_text: 妈咪？

entries.text: I am hardly your mother.
entries.source_text: I am hardly your mother.

entries.text: 我不是你妈妈。
entries.source_text: 我不是你妈妈。

entries.text: Nuh-uh?
entries.source_text: Nuh-uh?

entries.text: 不，唔？
entries.source_text: 不，唔？

entries.text: Poopie!
entries.source_text: Poopie!

entries.text: 爸爸！
entries.source_text: 爸爸！

entries.text: How dare you speak to me in that manner! You will be punished for your insolence! Guards!
entries.source_text: How dare you speak to me in that manner! You will be punished for your insolence! Guards!

entries.text: 你怎么能这样和我说话！你会因为你的无礼受到惩罚的，卫兵！
entries.source_text: 你怎么能这样和我说话！你会因为你的无礼受到惩罚的，卫兵！

entries.text: Perhaps one of our priests will discuss your needed education. Leave now.
entries.source_text: Perhaps one of our priests will discuss your needed education. Leave now.

entries.text: 也许我们的低级牧师可以教教你基本的待人接物，你走吧。
entries.source_text: 也许我们的低级牧师可以教教你基本的待人接物，你走吧。

entries.text: Have you studied the sacraments, child?
entries.source_text: Have you studied the sacraments, child?

entries.text: 你研习过圣经没有，孩子？
entries.source_text: 你研习过圣经没有，孩子？

entries.text: Yes.
entries.source_text: Yes.

entries.text: 是的。
entries.source_text: 是的。

entries.text: No.
entries.source_text: No.

entries.text: 没有。
entries.source_text: 没有。

entries.text: Then you would have known high elders of the Cathedral do not just 'hand out' blessings. You will leave now.
entries.source_text: Then you would have known high elders of the Cathedral do not just 'hand out' blessings. You will leave now.

entries.text: 那你就应该明白高级牧师不只是干“施与”祝福的工作，你可以走了。
entries.source_text: 那你就应该明白高级牧师不只是干“施与”祝福的工作，你可以走了。

entries.text: Continue to mock me and I will have you thrown out.
entries.source_text: Continue to mock me and I will have you thrown out.

entries.text: 再和我胡闹，我就把你扔出去！
entries.source_text: 再和我胡闹，我就把你扔出去！

entries.text: But I'm not mocking you, honest.
entries.source_text: But I'm not mocking you, honest.

entries.text: 可是我没有和您胡闹啊，真的。
entries.source_text: 可是我没有和您胡闹啊，真的。

entries.text: Mock you? Now why would I do something like that?!
entries.source_text: Mock you? Now why would I do something like that?!

entries.text: 胡闹？那我就换个花样怎么样！？
entries.source_text: 胡闹？那我就换个花样怎么样！？

entries.text: It's obvious that kindness and good temper aren't part of this religion.
entries.source_text: It's obvious that kindness and good temper aren't part of this religion.

entries.text: 善良和忍耐显然不是你们宗教的教义。
entries.source_text: 善良和忍耐显然不是你们宗教的教义。

entries.text: Sorry, I think I'll be leaving now.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I think I'll be leaving now.

entries.text: 对不起，那我走了。
entries.source_text: 对不起，那我走了。

entries.text: You will pay for those heretical words.
entries.source_text: You will pay for those heretical words.

entries.text: 你要为你的异端邪说而付出代价！
entries.source_text: 你要为你的异端邪说而付出代价！

entries.text: Your words do not match your conviction. They burn of the heresy within. You will be cleansed, then forgotten.
entries.source_text: Your words do not match your conviction. They burn of the heresy within. You will be cleansed, then forgotten.

entries.text: 从你的言辞中看不到一点悔改的意思，只有异端邪说，你会被净化的，然后永远地被人遗忘。
entries.source_text: 从你的言辞中看不到一点悔改的意思，只有异端邪说，你会被净化的，然后永远地被人遗忘。

entries.text: Then why are you here? What would bring you to the Children of the Cathedral?
entries.source_text: Then why are you here? What would bring you to the Children of the Cathedral?

entries.text: 那你在这里做什么呢？你来我们大教堂有何贵干？
entries.source_text: 那你在这里做什么呢？你来我们大教堂有何贵干？

entries.text: I am a seeker of knowledge. I would like to learn more.
entries.source_text: I am a seeker of knowledge. I would like to learn more.

entries.text: 我是知识的追寻者，我想学习。
entries.source_text: 我是知识的追寻者，我想学习。

entries.text: I need to know how to burn this place down, so I was looking for structural weaknesses.
entries.source_text: I need to know how to burn this place down, so I was looking for structural weaknesses.

entries.text: 我想知道怎么样才能把这个地方烧了，所以来看看建筑结构的弱点。
entries.source_text: 我想知道怎么样才能把这个地方烧了，所以来看看建筑结构的弱点。

entries.text: I'm just looking.
entries.source_text: I'm just looking.

entries.text: 来随便看看。
entries.source_text: 来随便看看。

entries.text: Are you a Child?
entries.source_text: Are you a Child?

entries.text: 你是教徒么？
entries.source_text: 你是教徒么？

entries.text: Lady, do I look that young to you?
entries.source_text: Lady, do I look that young to you?

entries.text: 老姐，你看我是那么年轻的人么？
entries.source_text: 老姐，你看我是那么年轻的人么？

entries.text: Am I one of the Children of the Cathedral? No.
entries.source_text: Am I one of the Children of the Cathedral? No.

entries.text: 我是不是大教堂教徒？不是。
entries.source_text: 我是不是大教堂教徒？不是。

entries.text: I am a devout believer.
entries.source_text: I am a devout believer.

entries.text: 我是一个虔诚的信徒。
entries.source_text: 我是一个虔诚的信徒。

entries.text: Then you should know better then to be here. I would caution you about your manners. Leave.
entries.source_text: Then you should know better then to be here. I would caution you about your manners. Leave.

entries.text: 那你就应该去参研经文，而不是在这里，要注意你的礼节，走吧。
entries.source_text: 那你就应该去参研经文，而不是在这里，要注意你的礼节，走吧。

entries.text: OK.
entries.source_text: OK.

entries.text: 好。
entries.source_text: 好。

entries.text: Bite me.
entries.source_text: Bite me.

entries.text: 扯你娘的蛋。
entries.source_text: 扯你娘的蛋。

entries.text: Are you interested in converting to our faith? We can offer you what no one else can...
entries.source_text: Are you interested in converting to our faith? We can offer you what no one else can...

entries.text: 你有兴趣皈依我们么？我可以给你其他人都不能给你的好处……
entries.source_text: 你有兴趣皈依我们么？我可以给你其他人都不能给你的好处……

entries.text: And what's that?
entries.source_text: And what's that?

entries.text: 是什么？
entries.source_text: 是什么？

entries.text: No, not interested. I think you're a bunch of kooks.
entries.source_text: No, not interested. I think you're a bunch of kooks.

entries.text: 不干，没兴趣，你们就是一帮疯子。
entries.source_text: 不干，没兴趣，你们就是一帮疯子。

entries.text: A lifetime of contentment. Fulfillment in the knowledge you're working to rebuild the planet and make a better place for those that follow.
entries.source_text: A lifetime of contentment. Fulfillment in the knowledge you're working to rebuild the planet and make a better place for those that follow.

entries.text: 满足的生活。充实的知识，让你用来重建这颗星球还有皈依我们之后更高贵的地位。
entries.source_text: 满足的生活。充实的知识，让你用来重建这颗星球还有皈依我们之后更高贵的地位。

entries.text: Sounds very interesting, could you tell me more? I seek fulfillment.
entries.source_text: Sounds very interesting, could you tell me more? I seek fulfillment.

entries.text: 听起来不错，你能说的仔细一点么？我想“实现”这些梦想。
entries.source_text: 听起来不错，你能说的仔细一点么？我想“实现”这些梦想。

entries.text: Oh yeah, I bet there's a lot of rebuilding going on and I'm sure your cups are overflowing with fulfillment.
entries.source_text: Oh yeah, I bet there's a lot of rebuilding going on and I'm sure your cups are overflowing with fulfillment.

entries.text: 好哇，我敢打赌到处都是造人计划，你的奶罩里会充实各种“实现”的。
entries.source_text: 好哇，我敢打赌到处都是造人计划，你的奶罩里会充实各种“实现”的。

entries.text: I don't think so. Sounds a little fishy to me.
entries.source_text: I don't think so. Sounds a little fishy to me.

entries.text: 不干，这里面有蹊跷。
entries.source_text: 不干，这里面有蹊跷。

entries.text: Believe what you will. Just do it elsewhere. You may leave.
entries.source_text: Believe what you will. Just do it elsewhere. You may leave.

entries.text: 随你怎么想，但别在这里胡言乱语，你可以走了。
entries.source_text: 随你怎么想，但别在这里胡言乱语，你可以走了。

entries.text: Mocking our holy cause is not appreciated. You will be punished if you continue.
entries.source_text: Mocking our holy cause is not appreciated. You will be punished if you continue.

entries.text: 讽刺我们崇高的事业是可耻的。你再这样就会被严惩！
entries.source_text: 讽刺我们崇高的事业是可耻的。你再这样就会被严惩！

entries.text: And who's going to do the punishing? Ooh, I'd like to request the extra hard whip, if you don't mind.
entries.source_text: And who's going to do the punishing? Ooh, I'd like to request the extra hard whip, if you don't mind.

entries.text: 谁来主罚啊？我提议加一条带劲的好鞭子，如果你喜欢的话。
entries.source_text: 谁来主罚啊？我提议加一条带劲的好鞭子，如果你喜欢的话。

entries.text: Sorry.
entries.source_text: Sorry.

entries.text: 对不起。
entries.source_text: 对不起。

entries.text: When the Children walk the reborn land, your kind will vanish, heretic. Leave now.
entries.source_text: When the Children walk the reborn land, your kind will vanish, heretic. Leave now.

entries.text: 当我们大教堂教徒在重生之地兴盛时，便是你们这些垃圾消亡的时候，走开！
entries.source_text: 当我们大教堂教徒在重生之地兴盛时，便是你们这些垃圾消亡的时候，走开！

entries.text: I am not completely devoid of humor, but leading the Children is something I take seriously. Please remember that.
entries.source_text: I am not completely devoid of humor, but leading the Children is something I take seriously. Please remember that.

entries.text: 我不是没有幽默感的人，但领导教众是一个很严肃的事情，你要记住。
entries.source_text: 我不是没有幽默感的人，但领导教众是一个很严肃的事情，你要记住。

entries.text: Sorry, I'm not that familiar with the Children.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I'm not that familiar with the Children.

entries.text: 对不起，我对教徒不是很熟悉。
entries.source_text: 对不起，我对教徒不是很熟悉。

entries.text: OK. Bye.
entries.source_text: OK. Bye.

entries.text: 好吧，再见。
entries.source_text: 好吧，再见。

entries.text: You are in the right place for spiritual fulfillment. The Children of the Cathedral seek a peaceful resolution of our world's problems and could use your help.
entries.source_text: You are in the right place for spiritual fulfillment. The Children of the Cathedral seek a peaceful resolution of our world's problems and could use your help.

entries.text: 这里就是精神“实现”的地方。教徒寻求世界问题的和平解决，你也许可以帮上点忙。
entries.source_text: 这里就是精神“实现”的地方。教徒寻求世界问题的和平解决，你也许可以帮上点忙。

entries.text: What are the Children's plans for mutants?
entries.source_text: What are the Children's plans for mutants?

entries.text: 教徒打算如何对待变种种族？
entries.source_text: 教徒打算如何对待变种种族？

entries.text: How can Children find peace in this wasteland?
entries.source_text: How can Children find peace in this wasteland?

entries.text: 教徒怎么样在荒原实现和平？
entries.source_text: 教徒怎么样在荒原实现和平？

entries.text: Those that can be brought into the fold, shall be. Those that resist will suffer.
entries.source_text: Those that can be brought into the fold, shall be. Those that resist will suffer.

entries.text: 那些愿意合作的可以在圈栏里苟活，那些抵抗的会很惨。
entries.source_text: 那些愿意合作的可以在圈栏里苟活，那些抵抗的会很惨。

entries.text: Sounds like a tough job.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a tough job.

entries.text: 听起来不是很简单。
entries.source_text: 听起来不是很简单。

entries.text: Now it's time for you to have a little suffering.
entries.source_text: Now it's time for you to have a little suffering.

entries.text: 现在也该你惨一下了！
entries.source_text: 现在也该你惨一下了！

entries.text: As it should be. May you succeed in your crusade!
entries.source_text: As it should be. May you succeed in your crusade!

entries.text: 是该这样的，希望你们的十字军行动成功！
entries.source_text: 是该这样的，希望你们的十字军行动成功！

entries.text: Uh, I got to go.
entries.source_text: Uh, I got to go.

entries.text: 呃，我走了。
entries.source_text: 呃，我走了。

entries.text: With perseverance, the Children can accomplish anything. We will not fail.
entries.source_text: With perseverance, the Children can accomplish anything. We will not fail.

entries.text: 只要有坚定不移的信念，我们教众就无往不利，我们不会失败的。
entries.source_text: 只要有坚定不移的信念，我们教众就无往不利，我们不会失败的。

entries.text: Good. I hope you don't.
entries.source_text: Good. I hope you don't.

entries.text: 好，我也希望你们不会失败。
entries.source_text: 好，我也希望你们不会失败。

entries.text: Yeah, right. Whatever.
entries.source_text: Yeah, right. Whatever.

entries.text: 对啊对啊，随你说啦。
entries.source_text: 对啊对啊，随你说啦。

entries.text: Okay. Bye.
entries.source_text: Okay. Bye.

entries.text: 好，再见。
entries.source_text: 好，再见。

entries.text: Blasphemer! This is a Holy House! How could you think such a thing?
entries.source_text: Blasphemer! This is a Holy House! How could you think such a thing?

entries.text: 亵渎者！这里是圣地！你怎么能想这些？
entries.source_text: 亵渎者！这里是圣地！你怎么能想这些？

entries.text: Relax, I didn't mean it!
entries.source_text: Relax, I didn't mean it!

entries.text: 别紧张啊，我不是故意的啊。
entries.source_text: 别紧张啊，我不是故意的啊。

entries.text: Easy. Let me show you.
entries.source_text: Easy. Let me show you.

entries.text: 别急，我会给你看的。
entries.source_text: 别急，我会给你看的。

entries.text: Blessings of the Holy Flame to you, my Child.
entries.source_text: Blessings of the Holy Flame to you, my Child.

entries.text: 愿圣火保佑你，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 愿圣火保佑你，我的孩子。

entries.text: Who's the Holy Flame?
entries.source_text: Who's the Holy Flame?

entries.text: 谁是圣火？
entries.source_text: 谁是圣火？

entries.text: This place is a sham.
entries.source_text: This place is a sham.

entries.text: 这个地方该生点火，暖和。
entries.source_text: 这个地方该生点火，暖和。

entries.text: And to you, Priestess Jain. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: And to you, Priestess Jain. Goodbye.

entries.text: 也祝福你，简恩牧师，再见了。
entries.source_text: 也祝福你，简恩牧师，再见了。

entries.text: Ug luk to ruk?
entries.source_text: Ug luk to ruk?

entries.text: 什么猪？
entries.source_text: 什么猪？

entries.text: Ooook!
entries.source_text: Ooook!

entries.text: 噢噢！
entries.source_text: 噢噢！

entries.text: Once you had potential. You are no longer welcome here.
entries.source_text: Once you had potential. You are no longer welcome here.

entries.text: 你要是真有这个能力就算你强。这里不欢迎你。
entries.source_text: 你要是真有这个能力就算你强。这里不欢迎你。

entries.text: You are not welcome here. Please leave.
entries.source_text: You are not welcome here. Please leave.

entries.text: 这里不欢迎你，走吧。
entries.source_text: 这里不欢迎你，走吧。

entries.text: What brings you here?
entries.source_text: What brings you here?

entries.text: 你来这里做什么？
entries.source_text: 你来这里做什么？

entries.text: I have slain the Master, and I believe he was masquerading as the Holy Flame.
entries.source_text: I have slain the Master, and I believe he was masquerading as the Holy Flame.

entries.text: 我杀了主教。他就是那个想伪装成伟大圣火的家伙。
entries.source_text: 我杀了主教。他就是那个想伪装成伟大圣火的家伙。

entries.text: You have been freed from the oppression of the Master.
entries.source_text: You have been freed from the oppression of the Master.

entries.text: 残酷压迫你们的主教已经归天了，你们自由了。
entries.source_text: 残酷压迫你们的主教已经归天了，你们自由了。

entries.text: Mu tuk doh tub?
entries.source_text: Mu tuk doh tub?

entries.text: 咂了啦？
entries.source_text: 咂了啦？

entries.text: Feeties.
entries.source_text: Feeties.

entries.text: 善布……
entries.source_text: 善布……

entries.text: You have done what? You shall pay for your sin against the Holy Flame himself.
entries.source_text: You have done what? You shall pay for your sin against the Holy Flame himself.

entries.text: 你干了什么？你对圣火犯下了不可饶恕的罪行！你会遭到惩罚的。
entries.source_text: 你干了什么？你对圣火犯下了不可饶恕的罪行！你会遭到惩罚的。

entries.text: The who?
entries.source_text: The who?

entries.text: 谁？
entries.source_text: 谁？

entries.text: The master. He was going to unite the mutants and take over the world.
entries.source_text: The master. He was going to unite the mutants and take over the world.

entries.text: 主教。他就是那个联合变种人想统治世界的家伙。
entries.source_text: 主教。他就是那个联合变种人想统治世界的家伙。

entries.text: Don't worry about it.
entries.source_text: Don't worry about it.

entries.text: 你不用操这个心了。
entries.source_text: 你不用操这个心了。

entries.text: You appear delusional. I suggest seeing a counselor to work out your problems.
entries.source_text: You appear delusional. I suggest seeing a counselor to work out your problems.

entries.text: 你神经错乱了，我建议你去医生那里看看。
entries.source_text: 你神经错乱了，我建议你去医生那里看看。

entries.text: I told you to leave. Are you deaf or feeble?
entries.source_text: I told you to leave. Are you deaf or feeble?

entries.text: 我叫你走，你是聋子还是弱智？
entries.source_text: 我叫你走，你是聋子还是弱智？

entries.text: Leave this room immediately or I will have you cleansed by holy flame.
entries.source_text: Leave this room immediately or I will have you cleansed by holy flame.

entries.text: 离开这里，否则我用圣火把你清除。
entries.source_text: 离开这里，否则我用圣火把你清除。

entries.text: There is no one greater then the Holy Flame and we are His servants.
entries.source_text: There is no one greater then the Holy Flame and we are His servants.

entries.text: 圣火是最高的领导，我们都是他的仆人。
entries.source_text: 圣火是最高的领导，我们都是他的仆人。

entries.text: Really? Wow. So, what's the reason for someone to join your order?
entries.source_text: Really? Wow. So, what's the reason for someone to join your order?

entries.text: 是吗？哦。那么你还要其他仆人做什么？
entries.source_text: 是吗？哦。那么你还要其他仆人做什么？

entries.text: Uh, okay. Bye.
entries.source_text: Uh, okay. Bye.

entries.text: 哦，好吧，再见。
entries.source_text: 哦，好吧，再见。

entries.text: Blessings of the Holy Flame to you, my Child.
entries.source_text: Blessings of the Holy Flame to you, my Child.

entries.text: 愿圣火保佑你，我的孩子。
entries.source_text: 愿圣火保佑你，我的孩子。

entries.text: With perseverance, the Children can accomplish anything. We will not fail.
entries.source_text: With perseverance, the Children can accomplish anything. We will not fail.

entries.text: It was the cleansing of the planet.  The inattention by those who came before caused the holy fires.  It was justice.

entries.text: 那是对地球的清洁。是先人的疏忽造成了圣火，它是公正的化身。

entries.text: There is no Master but the Holy Flame.  He is our master, He is the Master of all.
entries.source_text: There is no Master but the Holy Flame.  He is our master, He is the Master of all.

entries.text: 没有主教，只有圣火，圣火就是主教，他是万物的主教。
entries.source_text: 没有主教，只有圣火，圣火就是主教，他是万物的主教。

entries.text: The will of the Holy One brings a rebirth to the planet.  We are His Children and carry out His plan.

entries.text: 圣者的意志为我们的星球带来了重生。我们都是他的子民，受他差遣。

entries.text: They are holy for they bear marks of past sins for present witnesses.

entries.text: 他们背负了过去的罪衍，亲历现实，所以他们是神圣的。

entries.text: Like many other cities, they will embrace the moral leadership of the Cathedral.

entries.text: 和其他城市一样，哈勃城会拥护大教堂的领导的。

entries.text: They claim a religious foundation, but lack that which would make them truly righteous.  Their zeal is refreshing, however.

entries.text: The Holiest of Holies.  He is the guiding light we follow.  He shall cleanse those unfaithful when the Nexus of Rebirth is reached.

entries.text: It is the uniting, by the Holy Flame, of all people, of all races and the cleansing of the heathens from this world.
